title: Sunset Sail
text: Amazing from start to finish. Santi (the captain) was excellent at communication and answered all my questions promptly. When we arrived he met us at the entrance to the main port in his captain attire and we set sail on an excellent sunset cruise up the coast. Santi provided local Cava and fantastic tapas that we had aboard what is truly an exceptionally restored yacht! There we 12 of us and we could not have asked for a better experience. Thanks Santi and look forward to our next trip to Barcelona!!
author: KristianVandermere
